children: Millrose announced a planned offering of up to $1.0 billion of senior notes split into $500M 2029 and $500M 2031 tranches.
Offering up to $1.0 billion of senior notes: $500M due 2029 and $500M due 2031, subject to market conditions.
Notes offered only to qualified institutional buyers under Rule 144A and to non-U.S. persons under Regulation S.
Proceeds, plus $500M from a delayed draw term loan, intended for general corporate purposes, including possibly acquiring homesites from Dream Finders Transaction.
If Dream Finders Transaction isn’t completed by May 13, 2027, Millrose will use part of proceeds and/or cash to redeem $500M of the 2031 notes.
Notes and guarantees will not be registered under the Securities Act and cannot be sold in the U.S. without registration or an applicable exemption.
